title: Add stable visual material ownership
summary: Added a renderer-neutral material-owner registry that binds source and target motion ids to one continuant and holds visual authority between native endpoints with exact rewind sampling.

sourceRefs.summary: Defines stable material owner lookup and endpoint-native ownership frames.
Covers motion binding, intermediate material authority, endpoint handoff, and rewind symmetry.
